text:
alex: Morning — dense bay fog this AM. Ferry I usually take was delayed ~45m, spotted slowed BART on the Richmond line. Anyone planning to come in?
transit-bot: Ferry Service: Delayed 45 minutes due to low visibility. BART: Reduced speed advisory on Richmond/Millbrae lines. Live status: https://status.baytransit.example
maria: Ugh, on the 8:20 express that keeps stopping. Debating WFH vs slogging in to SoMa. Anyone near Embarcadero offering rides? :pleading_face:
ben: @maria I can swing by 16th & Mission in about 10 min and grab you if that helps. Leaving in a bit.
priya: Thanks @ben! I think I'm going to WFH today — streets look pretty messy and my calendar's clear until noon. Ping me if you need me on-site after 11.
jamie: Bike commute update: thefog made the bike path slick, almost low-sided on a corner. Lowered tire pressure saved me today. :bike:
maria: Ben legend :heart: Also, FYI — saw a tiny scooter pileup at Embarcadero (rental fleet); a couple tipped over because the dampness made them slide. Watch out if you're walking over there.
alex: Quick poll: react with :house: if WFH, :office: if heading in, :shrug: if undecided. Want to know who to expect for the lunch burrito run.
transit-bot: Reminder: Redwood shuttle on adjusted schedule this morning — check the Console -> Shuttle tab for updated pickup times.
priya: Reacted :house: — staying remote today.
ben: Reacted :office: — driving in, will have one passenger.
jamie: Reacted :shrug: — may bike in later depending on visibility.
